labels.label: context
labels.reason: This is a documentation pointer to the Django 3.0 release notes and requires no action at this release.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The urlquote, urlquote_plus, urlunquote and urlunquote_plus functions will be removed, so code calling them will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: force_text() and smart_text() will be removed, so code that imports or calls them will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The ugettext family of translation functions will be removed, so code using them will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: set_language() will stop writing the user language to request.session, which changes behavior for code that reads that session key.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Expression.get_group_by_cols() subclasses will be required to accept alias=None, so custom expressions must update their signatures.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: django.utils.text.unescape_entities() will be removed, so code calling it will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: django.utils.http.is_safe_url() will be removed, so code calling it will break.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: This is a documentation pointer to the Django 3.1 release notes and requires no action at this release.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The PASSWORD_RESET_TIMEOUT_DAYS setting will be removed, so projects still using it must switch to PASSWORD_RESET_TIMEOUT.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Using non-boolean right-hand values with the isnull lookup will no longer be allowed, so such queries will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The InvalidQuery exception class will be removed, so code that catches or imports it will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The django-admin.py entry point will be removed, so scripts or deployments invoking it must switch to django-admin.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: HttpRequest.is_ajax() will be removed, so views relying on it will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for the pre-3.1 CookieStorage cookie format will be removed, so old message cookies will no longer be read.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for pre-3.1 SHA-1 admin password reset tokens will be removed, so outstanding reset links using that format will stop working.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for the pre-3.1 session encoding format will be removed, so existing sessions in the old format will no longer load.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for SHA-1 signed django.core.signing.Signer signatures from before 3.1 will be removed, so those signatures will no longer validate.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for SHA-1 dumps() signatures in loads() from before 3.1 will be removed, so those values will fail to load.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for pre-3.1 SHA-1 user sessions will be removed, so those sessions will be invalidated and users must log in again.
